name: ALL DOMAINS — Social Post (webhook → FB Page + IG → ledger)
source: proposed patch — NOT applied to Make
design: New module 7 resolves page_id / ig_account_id / eligibility ONCE, as roundtrip variables. Both the post modules and the ledger rows read the resolved values, so a ledger row records where the post actually went.
A router (module 8) replaces the straight line. Route 0 = Facebook, Route 1 = Instagram, Route 2 = respond. Routes run in order, so the response is emitted last.

Route 2 has no filter, so the caller always gets a reply even when a channel is skipped. That is why the response module cannot simply be moved after the filtered Instagram module — a false filter on the main line would swallow the reply entirely.
Both send modules get a resume handler; a channel failure becomes a status instead of aborting the execution before the reply.
The response carries a per-channel receipt. ok is true only when every requested channel reached 'posted'.
